path_base: All file paths are relative to the project root in the ZIP, which contains package.json.
scope: The six final architectural scenes and all their delivered WebP files. No study image, interface concept image, temporary file or absolute workspace path is included.
disclosure: Original AI-generated concept visualizations of a fictional coastal building, created for INTERVAL. These are not documentary photographs of existing buildings and are not attributed to any real architect or photography practice.
generation_context: Prompts are preserved verbatim. Project-created visual context mentioned in a prompt was used only to maintain fictional materials, light and spatial continuity. Only the six final scenes and their encoded derivatives are catalogued. No third-party architectural photograph is incorporated.

processing.input_format: PNG returned by the built-in image generation tool
processing.small_operation: sharp(input).resize({ width: 1120, withoutEnlargement: true }).webp({ quality: 87, effort: 6 }).toFile(output)
post_generation_operations: Full-size WebP encoding at the original returned dimensions.
Proportional downsampling to 1120-pixel-wide WebP variants without enlargement.
Add adjacent JSON prompt metadata sidecars without changing image file bytes or decoded pixels.
processing.resolution_note: THRESHOLD was returned at 1672 x 941. The other five scenes were returned at 1586 x 992. Requested larger sizes in the prompts are not delivered pixel dimensions. Displaying these assets on a 4K viewport scales them; it does not make them native 4K imagery.
processing.production_copy_note: The production copies in dist/images are byte-identical to the matching source assets in public/images.

prompt_metadata.operation: One sequential metadata command per delivered WebP using the exact scene prompt.
prompt_metadata.storage: The tool uses adjacent <image>.webp.json sidecars for this format. No image was re-encoded.
prompt_metadata.binary_and_pixel_check: All 12 WebP file hashes and decoded RGB pixel hashes are identical before and after adding prompt metadata.
prompt_metadata.production_note: The public/images metadata sidecars are copied with public assets during the production build.
